prompt: Can a self-employed individual with gross sales below ₱3 million opt for the 8% income tax rate?
answer:
### Short Answer
Yes, a self-employed individual with gross sales below ₱3 million can opt for the 8% income tax rate, provided their gross sales or gross receipts do not exceed the VAT threshold of ₱3 million.

### Controlling Authorities
The relevant provision is found in Section 24(B)(1)(b) of the National Internal Revenue Code (NIRC), which allows self-employed individuals and professionals to choose an 8% tax on gross sales or gross receipts in excess of ₱250,000 in lieu of the graduated income tax rates.

### Interpretation
Under the NIRC, self-employed individuals whose gross sales or receipts do not exceed the VAT threshold (₱3 million) can avail themselves of the 8% income tax rate. This option is beneficial as it simplifies tax compliance and potentially reduces the overall tax burden compared to the graduated income tax rates.

### Practical Meaning
For self-employed individuals earning below ₱3 million, opting for the 8% tax rate can lead to easier tax calculations and filing. They will only need to pay tax on their income exceeding ₱250,000, which can be advantageous for managing their tax liabilities effectively.
